tool_args.rationale: The open-branch observations establish a strong gradient effect, but the fixed-horizon data leave the two-hop dynamics unidentified. A trajectory batch can distinguish candidate transfer laws before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating gradient-dependent bridge model now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven observations share the same horizon and initial state; they do not identify the trajectory or distinguish plausible two-layer transfer mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Simple bilinear mass action or Beverton–Holt recruitment
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed saturation rules against simple bilinear scaling, while the gradient-dependent probe rules against gradient-independent Beverton–Holt recruitment.
It does not resolve the mechanism or forecast-horizon ambiguity.
